headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high‑fliers and modest profit pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low single digits to over 50% YoY, led by Coforge's 53.6% surge. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and TCS, while Wipro and Persistent saw profit declines. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but remained stable or positive elsewhere. AI contributions were highlighted but specific revenue figures were limited.

themes.title: AI‑driven deals
themes.detail: Several firms cited AI‑led wins, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and LTM noting a 47% jump.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Despite revenue gains, companies like Infosys and Wipro faced modest or declining profit growth.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY, the strongest among peers.
Profit rose 21% YoY, driven by strong AI revenue.

laggards.why: Net profit fell 25% YoY despite revenue growth.
Profit slipped 1.9% YoY and headcount fell.
